questions.question: What is the status of ERC-8004 as of 2026-10-11?
questions.explanation: An EIP editor returned it from Review to Draft on 2026-01-13, and it remains Draft.

questions.question: Which registry is specified but not officially deployed?
questions.explanation: The contracts README lists no Validation Registry address on any chain.

questions.question: Where does proofOfPayment live?
questions.explanation: Only the off-chain feedback file carries it; the registry stores no payment data.

questions.question: What does getSummary do when clientAddresses is empty?
questions.explanation: It requires a non-empty list and reverts with "clientAddresses required".

questions.question: What happens to agentWallet when the agent token is transferred?
options: It moves to the new owner automatically
questions.explanation: The transfer clears it and the new owner must verify a wallet again.

questions.question: Which fields does the Reputation Registry store for each feedback?
questions.explanation: endpoint, feedbackURI and feedbackHash are emitted in the event but not stored.

questions.question: In the 2026-01-25 update, what replaced score?
questions.explanation: score became a signed int128 value with valueDecimals from 0 to 18.

questions.question: Who may not give feedback to an agent?
options: The agent owner and approved operators
questions.explanation: The owner and operators are barred; the reference code reverts with "Self-feedback not allowed".

questions.question: What did arXiv:2606.26028 find about live agents on Base (data to 2026-05-13)?
options: About 15% had a valid file and a live endpoint
questions.explanation: It found 3% on Ethereum, 4% on BSC and 15% on Base.

questions.question: How long ahead may the setAgentWallet deadline be in the reference code?
questions.explanation: MAX_DEADLINE_DELAY is 5 minutes; later deadlines revert with "deadline too far".
